description: Three articulated behaviors in a row, no blocks: open the drawer, press the button so the green LED turns on, slide the door from left to right. Each step is a behavior the base policy does on its own, so the result measures the multi-goal part (does the switch move on at the right time). No scale or alpha, the plan sets them (plan_drawer_button_door.json). Make it with dynaguide_scripts/make_task.py
